column1: # The MAVLink 2 messages the foreign judge reads (AET-WO-4400i D8: a closed table). Each CRC_EXTRA and payload length
# is computed from the message definitions in ArduPilot Copter-4.7.2's own submodule (fb773567,
# b3627df397e3354f26efe63559e1bcec4e72a4e4562ab52cbee1bab8f9e9999e, HEARTBEAT). CRC_EXTRA is the MAVLink rule: the
# X.25 CRC of the name and each base field's type and name (sorted by size, arrays with their length), its two bytes
# XORed; every value equals pymavlink 2.4.50's in the pinned ArduPilot image (spike/4400i/RESULTS.md §6.1).
# Columns, tab-separated: name, id, CRC_EXTRA, base payload length, payload length with extensions, and its use:
#   in   an input may carry it, and the judge decodes it when ArduPilot sends it;
#   out  only ArduPilot's own, decoded for the witness: an input carrying it is refused (InputMessageUnlisted).
